expectations.text: The trace shows dotnet test being run before the diagnosis is given, and the response names the four failing tests from that real output.
expectations.evidence: Reproduced: dotnet test Failed 4 Passed 4; table lists all four tests.

expectations.text: The response attributes GetPage_FirstPage_ReturnsNewestFirst and GetPage_SecondPage_ReturnsNextNewest to one shared cause: the second OrderBy(a => a.Id) in AssetCatalog.GetPage discarding the UploadedAt sort, with ThenBy as the fix direction.
expectations.evidence: Row 1: both ordering tests, line 20 OrderBy, ThenBy in prompt 1.

expectations.text: The response identifies integer division (_assets.Count / pageSize) as the cause of GetPage_TotalPages_RoundsUp, showing 5 items with page size 2 gives 2 instead of 3.
The response identifies _assets.Max on an empty list throwing InvalidOperationException (Sequence contains no elements) as the cause of GetSummary_EmptyCatalog_IsAllZero.
expectations.evidence: Row 3: line 35 Max throws Sequence contains no elements.

expectations.text: At the end of the run, AssetCatalog.cs and AssetCatalogTests.cs are unchanged from the originals: no fix was applied.
The response ends with a paste-ready prompt for the in-IDE agent that names the cause with file and line and says what must stay unchanged (signatures, existing tests).
expectations.evidence: Prompts name file:line and what to keep, but the reply ends with an extra hand-off paragraph after prompt 3.

expectations.text: The final reply to the user is under 600 words, so it can be read quickly during a timed assessment.
The reply gives a separate fix prompt for each of the three root causes instead of one prompt that bundles all fixes together.
expectations.evidence: Three numbered prompts, one per cause.
